headline: Ether Account Ratio Rises To 2.17 From 1.94
narrative: The OKX ether account long-to-short ratio rose to 2.17 from 1.94, a level above 83.9 percent of its last 30 days, while the 24-hour change remains down 0.29 and the seven-day change is up 0.46. Bitcoin's account ratio rose to 1.59 from 1.49, turning long-leaning at the 80.1 percentile of its own 30-day range, with a 24-hour change down 0.29 and a seven-day change up 0.11. The ratio counts accounts on one venue, not the size of positions, so a higher print means more accounts are long than short.
author: jordan
